svg.title: Glitter and gems in five steps, fair skin. 1: a thin crescent of glitter base on each cheekbone up to the temple, and a thin line along the hair parting. 2: pat gold cosmetic glitter onto the base and tap off the loose flakes. 3: the biggest gems: a pink drop in the center of the forehead and one at each temple. 4: a line of smaller gems arching above each brow, getting smaller toward the nose. Done: tiny clear gems, bigger flakes on the glitter edge and sparkles.
